meta.title: Rerum Novarum
meta.subtitle: On Capital and Labor
meta.author: Pope Leo XIII
meta.summary: Pope Leo XIII's foundational social encyclical on the condition of the working classes: it defends the natural right to private property and a just wage, rejects socialism as a false remedy, and sets out the duties of workers, employers, the Church, and the State.
